name: Payments Initiation
definition: Messages that support the initiation of a payment from the ordering customer to a financial institution that services a cash account and reporting its status.

name: Payments Clearing and Settlement
definition: Messages that support the clearing and settlement processes for payment transactions between financial institutions.

name: ATM Management
definition: Messages that support card related terminal management services between an Automated Teller Machine (ATM) and an Acquirer.

name: Cash Management
definition: Messages that support the reporting and advicing of the cash side of any financial transactions, including cash movements, transactions and balances, plus any exceptions and investigations related to cash transactions.

name: Administration
definition: Generic messages, ie, system event notifications, generic rejections, etc.

name: Payments Remittance Advice
definition: Messages that support communication between creditors and debtors regarding remittance details associated with payments.

name: Account Management
definition: Messages that support the management of account related activities, such as the opening and maintenance of an account.

name: Business Application Header
definition: Header that contains business information that is relevant before processing a message.

name: Securities Management
definition: Messages that support post-settlement processes for securities (including reporting on securities movements, trades and balances), the processes required to protect beneficial owner's rights throughout settlement, plus any exceptions and investigations related to securities transactions.
